items.question: From what date did the UAE Labour law, Federal Decree Law No. 33 of 2021 as amended, take effect in the private sector?
items.gold: The law became effective on 2 February 2022.
items.fact: UAE Labour law effective 2 February 2022, replacing 1980 law

items.question: Does the UAE labour law for the private sector permit 'unlimited' type employment contracts?
items.gold: No, the law abolished unlimited contracts and admits only limited or fixed-term contracts.
items.fact: UAE labour law abolished unlimited contracts; only limited or fixed-term
